2025_083_august_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for August 2025, submitted to the Board of Education for its October 14, 2025 meeting. The 28-page listing, footer-dated 10/10/25, itemizes every card charge and credit by transaction description, journal-entry description (uniformly AUGUST 2025 PCARD EXP), accounting code, date and amount, covering activity dated 7/28/25 through 8/25/25. The report closes with a printed total of 271,101.65. The largest single line is 9,792.25 to PRODRINKINGFOUNTAINS on 8/8/25, charged to accounting code 1019022614471006410.
